Morphology General Habit
    Annual, viscid-pubescent, 15–40 cm., simple or branched from a little  above  base upwards
Morphology Stem
    Stem and leaves somewhat rough with rather coarse glandular hairs
Morphology Leaves
    Basal leaves petiolate, usually pinnatisect or pinnatifid with lobes dentate or pinnatifid, rarely acutely lobed; median stem leaves sessile, mostly pinnatifid, auriculate, amplexicaul, 3.5–7 × 0.8– 4 cm; upper leaves similar but reducing, pinnatifid to linear and dentate
Morphology Reproductive morphology Inflorescences
    Inflorescence a lax corymb with several showy capitula
